paragraphs: R' Abba bar Mamal, Bava Batra 19a.
Rav Assi bar Mamal, Gittin 3:8. R' Vira bar Mamal, Kiddushin 9a [the named passage reads Rabbi Zeira].
R' Yehoshua bar Mamal, a Tanna, Nazir 56b.

notes.text: The frozen source reads Vira; earlier machine text read Zeira. That name question remains unresolved, without changing the supplied Hebrew.

The saved whole Davidson Kiddushin9a scalar explicitly has Rabbi Zeira bar Mamal. Supplied Vira and older machine Zeira remain alongside that named form, without proving which letter was printed. Its full Rabbi does not automatically determine the unresolved Vira title or the other names in this list. Source Rav Assi is explicit; Abba, Yehoshua and Lili keep abbreviated R'. Tanna remains Hyman’s parenthetical classification. Doubled periods in19a/9a, single period in12a, and Gittin3:8 are distinct locators; no family tree or authority merger follows.

The consulted scan of Hyman, volume III, printed p. 883, retains וירא in this list; the directly consulted Davidson Kiddushin 9a reads רבי זירא בר ממל. Thus Zeira is a separate witnessed reading, not a silent correction to the supplied Vira. The consulted Yerushalmi Gittin 3:8 names Chinena, son of Rav Assi bar Mamal; Nazir 56b transmits Rabbi Yehoshua bar Memel between Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Yehoshua, and Davidson Yevamot 12a calls Lili Rav. The supplied abbreviated titles and Hyman’s Tanna classification are retained. These patronymic notices do not establish that the five men shared one father or constitute one authority record.
